snippet.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Official Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Learn more about the story of Tainted Grail: Fall of Avalon in this latest trailer for the first-person, open-world RPG. Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in Tainted Grail: Fall of Avalon. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends, and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline. Tainted Grail: Fall of Avalon will be available on PC, PS5 (PlayStation 5), and Xbox Series X/S on May 23, 2025. Tainted Grail: Fall of Avalon is out now in Steam Early Access.
